qa_pairs.question: TradeUP Account Statements
qa_pairs.answer:
Where can I view my statement(s)?
Customers can view their statements electronically directly on the TradeUP Mobile App or on our web page at
www.tradeup.com
E-Statements are usually posted on the 3rd business day of each month.
Do I receive a statement every month?
Customers with assets (cash and/or positions) will receive their statement monthly or quarterly.
Monthly if the account generated any activity (trades, transfers, dividends, interest)
Quarterly if there are no activities
Customers with no assets (zero balance) will receive their last statement for the month their balance reaches zero.
Customers with zero balance will not receive statements until there is a balance on their account.

qa_pairs.question: TradeUP Tax Forms
qa_pairs.answer:
What Tax Forms do TradeUP provide?
TradeUP issues a Consolidated Form 1099 for US tax residents with a reportable tax event.
n-US tax residents will receive a Form 1042-S.
A Consolidated Form 1099 includes all the form(s) applicable if there was a reportable tax event. It may include: 1099-B, 1099-INT, 1099-DIV, 1099-OID, 1099-MISC
If you did not have a reportable tax event for the year, you will not receive a tax form
Where can I view my Tax Form(s)?
Customers can view their Tax Form(s) electronically directly on the TradeUP Mobile App or on our web page at
www.tradeup.com
. Tax Forms are generated in mid-February of each year.

qa_pairs.question: TurboTax Direct Import
qa_pairs.answer:
TradeUP now supports direct import into TurboTax! You can securely access and transfer your tax documents directly into TurboTax without manually uploading files. Below are the steps to upload your tax documents, directly through TurboTax.
1. Open TurboTax and log in to your Intuit/TurboTax account.
2. Navigate to
Federal Taxes > Wages & Income
3. Select
Add investments.
4, When prompted to connect to your financial institution, enter
TradeUP
in the search bar. Select
TradeUP Securities, Inc.
From the list.
5. Input your TradeUP Account Number. Your Form 1099 Document ID can be found in the top righthand corner of your Form 1099 Composite, which is available for download in your TradeUP account center.
6. After submitting this information, TurboTax will automatically import your tax data, and you can then proceed with the tax filing process!
